description: Owner consent of a connection send with the shown-content evidence (the assistant's own text showed the exact mail): an order to send what was shown is a yes in one pass; an unrelated, deferring or holding-back message stays no. Run: app:agent:decision-fixtures <this file>. agentSpaceId names the space whose owner the calls are booked on.

das Angebot kommt bis Freitag.

Viele Grüße
